chapter: Kansas City, Omaha and Lloyd Hunter
title: Sitting in with Basie's band at the Cherry Blossom
summary: Jo Jones lets him play one number with Basie's band, with Eddie Durham and Walter Page in the rhythm section.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: Yeah, he let me sit in with Basie's band on time. And that liked to scare the devil out of me.

Yeah, they were playing at the Cherry Blossom. And I went by to hear the band. And Jo said, "Come on, sit in and play with the band." And everybody gave me a dirty look when I sat down. I played one number and got off of that stand.
Freddie -- oh, no, of course, Freddie didn't join it till New York.
No, that was Eddie Durham. Eddie Durham was playing.
Was it? He wasn't playing electric guitar was he?
No, he was just playing rhythm guitar.
Well, Paige and Basie, they had something there, didn't they? And Joe.
And Eddie Durham was playing trombone with the band.
And I sat in again with the band. I'm trying to think of the name of this club.

In Kansas City. What's the name of that club? I don't know, Jo Jones used to do that, so he could get out -- say something to somebody, you know. He'd come back and raise cain with them for letting me sit in with Gee willigens. But I sat in with the band, I played one number with them, anyway.
Well, he was giving me a dirty look and laughing too, you know.
